messages.subject: Error in startServer(host, port, handlerManager$createHttpuvApp()) :    Failed to create server
parts:
I am running Sleuth on Rstudio. I was able to load shiny with the sleuth_live(so) command. The data looked great. While i was attempting to save one of the graphs as an image, shiny and Rstudio closed. When relaunching Rstudio and executing the sleuth_live(so) command to launch shiny I get the following error:

> sleuth_live(so)
Loading required package: shiny

Listening on http://127.0.0.1:42427
Error in startServer(host, port, handlerManager$createHttpuvApp()) : 
  Failed to create server

Is someone familiar with this error? What can I do to resolve the issue?
